## V.4

- **PNEUMA:** "Yet he did not put their children to death, following what is written in the Law, in the Book of Moses, where the LORD commanded: "Parents must not be"

## V.19
- **EMET:** "You-said behold you-struck Edom and-it-lifted-you your-heart to-boast now stay in-your-house why should-you-engage-in-strife with-evil and-you-fall yo"

## V.22
